verdict.rationale: Cal.com runs a first-party hosted MCP server at mcp.cal.com. Its docs say it lets users "manage bookings, event types, schedules, and more through natural language in any MCP-compatible client" (cal-com-docs-30/49), using OAuth with no API key (cal-com-docs-66), and it can also set up team event types and add people to teams (cal-com-docs-67). The probe confirmed the MCP server documentation exists (cal-com-probe-4). Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface inside the Cal.com app itself (the user needs an external AI client), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the natural-language commands work reliably.
